text: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree?
prompt: What is the time complexity of searching in a balanced Binary Search Tree?
explanation: A balanced BST divides search space in half at each step, yielding logarithmic O(log n) time.

text: In offline computer vision proctoring, what metric is typically used to detect natural blinks without false gaze diversion?
prompt: In offline computer vision proctoring, what metric is typically used to detect natural blinks without false gaze diversion?

options.text: Euler Yaw angle greater than 45 degrees

text: Which data structure is best suited for implementing a server-side LRU cache?
prompt: Which data structure is best suited for implementing a server-side LRU cache?

options.text: Hash Map combined with Doubly Linked List

explanation: Combining a hash map for O(1) lookup with a doubly linked list for O(1) node repositioning gives optimal LRU cache performance.

text: Which protocol is strictly recommended for production WebSocket communication?
prompt: Which protocol is strictly recommended for production WebSocket communication?
explanation: wss:// encrypts traffic via TLS, preventing eavesdropping and proxy tampering.

text: In atomic file writing, what technique guarantees crash resilience?
prompt: In atomic file writing, what technique guarantees crash resilience?

options.text: Writing to a temporary sibling file and executing an atomic filesystem rename
Flushing console logs before each write

explanation: Atomic rename replaces the target file atomically at the OS filesystem level, preventing partially-written corrupted files.

prompt: What does the Euler yaw angle measure in head pose estimation?

options.text: Horizontal turning of the head (looking left or right)
Vertical tilting of the head (looking up or down)
Distance of the nose from the webcam
